slides: Fear is what you hide from
The brave don't feel less fear They just stop lying about it
You won't even say the word fear
But it's just cowardice dressed up
All your wisdom is just fear talking
Follow for men brave enough to see themselves
caption: Your fear is hiding behind a nice name. Most men call it prudence. Discipline and mindset come when you stop lying. Self improvement is naming poverty fear, criticism fear, and death fear. Success lives on the other side of admitting these three. This is the real lesson. Send this to a man who needs it today. #discipline #selfimprovement #mindset #mentalstrength #success
